call_points.text: Giga 1 plant expected to commercialise in H1 FY28; the 10 GWh BESS and E Positive facilities are on earlier timelines.
Customer qualification plant with multi-form, multi-chemistry capability was inaugurated in July 2026.
A 3% price rise in June partly offset alloy, sulfuric acid and poly costs; a further 2-3% is being rolled out.
Four-wheeler aftermarket volumes grew about 15% and OEM volumes about 24%; two-wheeler OEM volumes grew over 35%.
Automotive exports fell about 20% on Middle East volume loss; management expects recovery in coming quarters.
Cathode material must be procured from China; management is not aware of specific restrictions on battery cathode or anode material.
Cell R&D spend may be ₹100-150 Cr this year; management declined to give an LFP product timeline.
Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board revoked the 2021 closure order on July 18, 2026, and the company withdrew its High Court writ petition.
Amara Raja guided for FY27 capex in the range of ₹1,500 Cr to ₹1,700 Cr, with ₹1,100 Cr to ₹1,200 Cr allocated to the New Energy business.
Management expects 13% EBITDA margin to remain achievable over the medium term despite high lead prices.

operating_notes.text: Amaron Assist, launched 7 May 2026, is a domestic automotive, battery and spares services brand under Amaron; the filing gives no revenue, investment or timeline.
Q4FY26 raw material cost was 68.5% of revenue, up 28.5% YoY, while purchases of stock-in-trade fell 47.2% YoY.
FY26 capex was ₹1,341.06 Cr against operating cash flow of ₹1,118.29 Cr; capital work in progress stood at ₹1,584.66 Cr at Mar-2026.
Total investment in wholly-owned Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies stood at ₹1,500.01 Cr after a ₹100 Cr infusion in Q4FY26.
Cumulative supply of telecom packs crossed 1GWh during Q4-FY26.
Cumulative installation of telecom packs crossed 1 GWh during FY26.
Tubular manufacturing plant operated at 100% capacity in Q1FY27, with traded batteries at about 15% of lead-acid revenue to meet excess demand.
Combined market share in the telecom segment was over 60% in Q1FY27, with lithium-ion telecom volumes up about 50%.
Management estimates a 15-20% price disadvantage versus Chinese cell imports today.

timeline.summary: Ramachandra Naidu Galla, Director of Amara Raja Enterprises Private Limited, declared no promoter encumbrances for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
On 6 May 2026, Amara Raja announced the launch of 'Amaron Assist' automotive and battery services under its flagship Amaron brand, effective 7 May 2026, aimed at creating additional revenue pools.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,535.75 Cr, net profit ₹314.33 Cr.
Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited’s Board recommended ₹5.2 final dividend per share on May 25, 2026.
Amara Raja reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,537 Cr and PAT of ₹314 Cr, alongside progress on its New Energy giga corridor.
Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited shared the earnings call recording on May 26, 2026, via its website.

On 2 June 2026, Amara Raja Energy & Mobility filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call held on May 26, 2026, highlighting FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹13,814 Cr and new energy expansion plans.

Additional Commissioner, CGST (Appeals), Meerut upheld the original order passed by Assistant Commissioner, Ghaziabad on December 15, 2025, under Section 107 of CGST/UPGST Act, 2017; order dated October 15, 2026.
